about_short_description.short_description: Warp is the AI-native employee management platform designed for ambitious companies.

product.name: US Payroll
product.description: Full-service payroll processing for employees and contractors across all 50 US states, automating wage calculation, tax deductions, and payments.

product.name: State Tax Compliance
product.description: Automates state-level tax deductions, filings, and consolidates multiple compliance accounts into a single platform.

product.name: Health & 401(k) Benefits
product.description: Provides small group or ICHRA health coverage and automates syncing of health benefits deductions with payroll, including 401(k) plan setup.

product.name: Global Contractors
product.description: Enables hiring, onboarding, and paying global contractors in over 150 countries, supporting payments in local currencies or US dollars.

product.name: Warp benefits brokerage
product.description: A benefits brokerage service integrated into Warp’s platform to manage employee benefits and carrier relationships.
